title: LLM作为评判者的可靠性与偏见研究
summary: 系统评估LLM作为评判者的可靠性，发现单次评判平均13.6%的偏好翻转率，存在首位偏见，跨评判一致性仅76%。建议采用多轮聚合、位置随机化和不确定性报告。
summary_en: Systematic evaluation of LLM-as-a-Judge reliability reveals 13.6% average preference flip rate, first-position bias, and only 76% cross-judge agreement. Recommends multi-trial aggregation, position randomization, and uncertainty reporting.
